# IconButton

32px round icon button with the Bencho hover wash.

`OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.IconButton` · 08 Core

## Use

```jsx
<OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.IconButton label="…">…</OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.IconButton>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.IconButton" label="…">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

32px round icon button with the Bencho hover wash and press. `active`/`pressed` keeps the wash on. Always pass `label`.
